revision: r1 (2026-11-11): first script from the batch-3 brief (docs/pitches/batch3_script_briefs/singing_box.md; round 2 #1 with the critic's line-1 fix and must-fixes). Reviews in reviews/.
caption: where do her diamonds go 💎
logline: An allay carries every diamond its miner's TNT blasts loose to the singing box in the mine wall, sure the box is just hungry, while she climbs out empty-handed every night; today it brings diamond 32 through the hole, to the neighbor in full diamond armour tapping the box.
question: why has she never had more than one diamond?
premise: A miner under Torch Hill gives her allay her only diamond so it collects more. Every day her TNT blasts diamonds loose, and the allay flies every one to the singing box: a note block in a little hole in the mine wall, right by the lava she never goes near. The box sings whenever the allay comes close, and the diamonds vanish ('it must be so hungry'). She climbs out with empty hands every night: 'Nothing again. It's empty.' The grumpy neighbor yells about the noise.
twist: The note block isn't hers. The neighbor dug a secret room beside her tunnel and taps his note block through the hole every few seconds. Vanilla: an allay that hears a note block played within 16 blocks delivers its items there instead of to its player, for 30 s, and each note resets it. So her allay has delivered all 31 diamonds to him, and he wears them (full diamond armour, pickaxe, sword: 29 of them). Diamond 32 lands at his feet as he taps. Cut on the tap.
payoff_note: `tap`: the stunt mark when the neighbor's hand taps the note block in S13; the Short ends <= 1.0 s after it. No line after L14; the picture is the reveal (STANDARDS 0, 3).

world.place: torch_hill_cottages (new, to claim at build time): two players' cottages on the lowland under Torch Hill, between the Digger's House (-245, 67, -650) and the old torch shaft (-290, 44..84, -684), inside digger_house's footprint or just west of it. Her mine is the old torch shaft, extended from y 44 down to y -54 with a ladder, and a tunnel east at y -54 (diamond depth; the lava aquifer level). His secret room is beside the tunnel, 1 block of deepslate between, reached by his own ladder from his cottage; a 1x1 hole joins them high in the wall over the lava pool. set.md has the numbers.

lines.text: I've found her / THIRTY-ONE diamonds. / She's never had / more than ONE.
lines.say: I've found her thirty-one diamonds. She's never had more than ONE.
lines.direction: amazed and proud, one quick bright breath

lines.text: I'm her ALLAY. / She gave me / her one diamond / to HOLD, / so I know / what to LOOK for.
lines.say: I'm her allay. She gave me her one diamond to hold, so I know what to LOOK for.

lines.text: Then she lights / the BOOM blocks / and RUNS.
lines.say: Then she lights the boom blocks and RUNS.

lines.text: BOOM! / And DIAMONDS / go bouncing / EVERYWHERE.
lines.say: Boom! And diamonds go bouncing EVERYWHERE.
lines.direction: delighted, the best part of the day

lines.text: So I catch / them ALL, / and fly them / to the singing BOX. / Every allay knows / that's where / your finds GO.
lines.say: So I catch them all, and fly them to the singing box. Every allay knows that's where your finds GO.
lines.direction: busy and proud, matter-of-fact on the last sentence

lines.text: It lives / in a little hole / in the WALL, / right by the glowy / orange WATER. / She says / never go NEAR that.
lines.say: It lives in a little hole in the wall, right by the glowy orange water. She says never go NEAR that.
lines.direction: cheerful tour guide, repeating her rule like a good student

lines.text: And the box SINGS / every time / I come CLOSE. / It's SO happy / to see me!
lines.say: And the box sings every time I come close. It's so happy to SEE me!

lines.text: I drop them / right ON it. / And when I look BACK, / they're GONE. / It must be / so HUNGRY.
lines.say: I drop them right on it. And when I look back, they're gone. It must be so HUNGRY.

lines.text: Every NIGHT, / she climbs out / of the mine / with EMPTY hands.
lines.say: Every night, she climbs out of the mine with EMPTY hands.
lines.direction: the bounce drops a little, puzzled

lines.text: Some of us / are trying / to SLEEP!
lines.say: Some of us are trying to SLEEP!

lines.text: She looks / so TIRED. / So today, / I'm finding her / the BIGGEST one YET.
lines.say: She looks so tired. So today, I'm finding her the biggest one YET.

lines.text: And the box SANG, / so I flew it / through the little HOLE, / right to the / singing BOX.
lines.say: And the box sang, so I flew it through the little hole, right to the singing BOX.
lines.direction: happy, flying, the last word bright; it runs into the picture
